title: 第3章 元气气旋三日开脉此乃天帝转世第4章 三天大找个童养媳
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
三天之后，叶家大院后方的庭院之中。
小女孩儿如银铃般欢快的笑声传出，叶娇娇和叶轻眉两个小堂姐正在伸手逗弄躺在摇摇椅里面的叶天澜。
而旁边不远处就是李秀清在和两个嫂嫂聊着天，一派其乐融融的景象。
从这里能够看见不远处演武场内部的情况，那里面基本上都是一些老爷子从王都举家来到此地之时，所带过来的一些忠诚随从，以及他们的晚辈。
真正的叶家人，实际上整个偌大庄园之内也就只有十人而已。
但却是整个叶族内部的绝对核心。
此时躺在摇摇椅里面的叶天澜十分纠结。
大姐叶轻眉喜欢捏他耳垂，而二姐叶娇娇又喜欢掐他脸蛋。
一方面他感觉怪怪的，可另一方面他又觉得···
真香啊。
咳咳，不是物理意义上的那个香，虽然也有。
但更多是精神意义上的。
得益于两位堂姐的大力帮助，此时他身体之中的第一条主经脉在天地间源源不竭的元力冲击之下，已经来到了最后即将完全打通的边缘。
只要能够将第一条人体天生堵塞的经脉给打通，那么他便能够成为一名真正的开脉境武者！
以三日之姿！
也不知道这个速度和老爹他们口中的古之大帝相比较起来如何。
算了，我小澜子还是安心修炼吧，顺便给他们来上一点小小的鲨鱼震撼。
心中一动，随着一声只有他自己能够听到清脆琉璃破碎声响起，叶天澜倏然间闭上了眼睛。
下一刻，一道蓬勃的气势从他身上喷薄而出，引得空气震动，四周天地间的元力尽数汇聚而来。
竟是在短短片刻之内便形成了一道小型的漏斗状气旋，盘旋在他天灵盖上方三寸之处，源源不断的元力如鲸吞长吸一般汇入其中。

突如其来的惊人变化直接将正在逗弄叶天澜的两姐妹给吓懵逼了，忙不迭的将手掌缩了回来，一脸惊恐状的瞪大了双眼。
随后开始惊慌失措的大叫起来。
“母亲，母亲，你们快来看看，弟弟这是怎么了？”
两个小女孩儿直接就被吓哭了，她们本能的以为是自己把弟弟给玩坏了，心中充斥满了惶恐与不安。
而此时，原本还在笑谈着的三位贵妇人也是从天地间元气的流动和两人的惊呼中察觉到了事情的不对劲。
李秀清更是脸色一变，锻体境巅峰的速度一下子爆发，用最快的速度冲到了紧闭双眼的叶天澜面前。
正当她伸手，满眼焦急的准备去抱起自己孩子时，动作一下子就停顿在了半空中。
一双美眸迅速睁大，接着眼中浮现出浓郁到极致的不可置信之色。
伸手死死的捂住红唇，从口中极其艰难的吐出。
“元气气旋？！？”
“什么？？！”
听闻这个字眼，接连赶过来的大嫂和二嫂同样震惊的呆滞在了原地。
什么是元气气旋？
那可是只有武者在初步踏入通脉境的时候才能够沟通天地元力所产生的特殊小型异象！
简单来说便是，一旦武者开启了元气气旋，那么便获得了元气流转经脉的资格，从此便可以以气入体，鱼跃龙门，真正意义上踏入修炼之道！
锻体境顶多就是一介江湖武夫，和普通人相比较起来也不过就力气稍微大些，行动敏捷一些。
可一旦踏入开脉境，体内经脉打通足以容纳元气之时，那便可修炼真正的武道法门，从此走上通天大道！
两者宛若云泥之别！
两人本能的想去质疑李秀清的话语，可是当他们看见那道浮现在叶天澜天灵盖上的元气气旋之时，这一刻心中所有的质疑声音全部消失掉。
content_en:
Three days later, in the courtyard behind the Ye family compound.
The little girl's cheerful laughter sounded like silver bells. Two little cousins, Ye Jiaojiao and Ye Qingmei, were reaching out to tease Ye Tianlan who was lying in the rocking chair.
Not far away, Li Xiuqing was chatting with her two sisters-in-law, looking very happy.
From here, you can see the internal situation of the martial arts arena not far away, which is basically filled with some loyal followers brought by some old men when their families came here from the royal capital, as well as their juniors.
There are actually only ten people in the real Ye family in the entire large manor.
But it is the absolute core within the entire Ye Clan.
Ye Tianlan, who was lying in the rocking chair at this time, was very confused.
The eldest sister Ye Qingmei likes to pinch his earlobes, while the second sister Ye Jiaojiao likes to pinch his cheeks.
On the one hand, he felt weird, but on the other hand, he felt...
It smells so good.
Ahem, it's not the fragrance in the physical sense, although it does exist.
But it’s more of a spiritual sense.
Thanks to the great help of his two cousins, at this time, the first main meridian in his body was on the verge of being completely opened under the impact of the endless energy between heaven and earth.
As long as he can open up the first meridian that is naturally blocked in the human body, then he can become a true pulse-opening realm warrior!
In three days of appearance!
I don’t know how this speed compares with the ancient emperor that dad and the others call him.
Forget it, I, Xiao Lanzi, should just practice with peace of mind, and give them a little shark shock by the way.
His heart moved, and with a crisp sound of glass breaking that only he could hear, Ye Tianlan suddenly closed his eyes.
The next moment, a vigorous momentum spurted out from his body, causing the air to vibrate, and all the energy from the surrounding heaven and earth gathered together.
In just a few moments, a small funnel-shaped cyclone was formed, hovering three inches above his Tianling Cap, and a steady stream of energy flowed into it like a whale swallowing a long breath.
The sudden and shocking change frightened the two sisters who were teasing Ye Tianlan. They hurriedly retracted their hands and their eyes widened in horror.
Then he started shouting in panic.
"Mother, mother, come and see, what's wrong with my brother?"
The two little girls were frightened and cried. They instinctively thought that they had spoiled their younger brother, and their hearts were filled with fear and uneasiness.
At this time, the three ladies, who were still laughing and talking, also noticed that something was wrong from the flow of vitality between heaven and earth and the two people's exclamations.
Li Xiuqing's expression changed even more, and her speed at the peak of the Body Forging Realm suddenly exploded, and she rushed as fast as possible in front of Ye Tianlan, who had her eyes closed tightly.
Just as she stretched out her hand to pick up her child with anxious eyes, her movement suddenly stopped in mid-air.
A pair of beautiful eyes widened quickly, and then a look of extreme disbelief appeared in them.
He stretched out his hand to cover his red lips and spit it out with great difficulty.
"Vitality Cyclone?!?"
"What??!"
Hearing this word, the eldest sister-in-law and the second sister-in-law who rushed over one after another were equally shocked and froze in place.
What is a vitality cyclone?
That is a special small-scale phenomenon that only warriors can communicate with when they first enter the Tongmai realm!
To put it simply, once a warrior activates the vitality cyclone, he or she is qualified to flow the vitality through the meridians. From then on, he can enter the body with energy, jump over the dragon's gate, and step into the path of cultivation in a true sense!
At best, those in the body-forging realm are just like martial arts warriors. Compared with ordinary people, they are only slightly stronger and more agile.
But once you step into the realm of opening meridians and the meridians in your body are opened enough to accommodate your vitality, you can then practice real martial arts and embark on the road to heaven!
The two are like clouds and mudThe difference!
The two of them instinctively wanted to question Li Xiuqing's words, but when they saw the cyclone of vitality emerging on Ye Tianlan's Tianling Cap, all doubts in their hearts disappeared at this moment.
